MOTIVATION_ONLY: docs/research/OWNER_CARDS_R03_RESULT.md hypothesis R03-C1; verdict unchanged; its estimate is not an input
QUESTION: Does stratifying the 1h rank reference distributions by UTC weekday type (Mon-Fri vs Sat-Sun) improve the calibration of unusual-hour flags against their nominal rates without degrading holdout/prospective calibration and without raising false alerts in other regimes?
BASELINE_C0: rank of the rolling-1h value at t against the rolling-1h values at every 5m step in [t-30d, t), all weekdays pooled; mature by span >= 30d

CANDIDATE_C1.reference: same, restricted to window ends on UTC dates of the same weekday type as t
CANDIDATE_C1.weekday_type_rule: UTC date of the window end; Sat/Sun = WEEKEND

COUNTING_UNIT: non-overlapping hourly windows (window end on the hour); 5m-step rates reported beside

GUARDRAIL_CELLS.rv_tercile: trailing-30d realized volatility tercile; edges fixed from Stage H discovery years

METRICS.exceedance_gap: G_S(s,m) = share(rank >= 0.95; price either tail) - nominal
METRICS.primary: P_S = max over primary strata (WEEKDAY, WEEKEND) and metrics of |G_S|
METRICS.uniformity: Kolmogorov distance of ranks to uniform, descriptive

GUARDRAILS.no_over_flagging: G_C1 <= G_C0 + 0.01 per primary stratum and metric
GUARDRAILS.no_under_flagging: G_C1 >= -0.02 per primary stratum and metric
GUARDRAILS.coverage: qualified share of TRIGGERED hours not down by more than 0.05 per stratum (prospective stage; NOT_ASSESSABLE_ON_PROXY otherwise)

H.data: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 1m 2020-01..2024-12, single-venue proxy of the product 5m tape
H.label: PROXY_SINGLE_VENUE_EXPOSED

P.data: beta state tape schema V2 from 2026-10-01
P.PROSPECTIVE_START: set at freeze: first UTC date with usable weekend ranks under both C0 and C1 (about 2026-10-31)
P.PROSPECTIVE_END: START + 56 days or min N, whichever later; hard stop START + 84 days

DECISION_RULE.H_PASS: P_C1 <= P_C0 - 0.01 on the proxy holdout and all guardrails hold
DECISION_RULE.H_FAIL: P_C1 > P_C0 + 0.005 or any guardrail breached
DECISION_RULE.P_PASS: min N met; |G_C1| <= 0.02 for both primary strata and all metrics; all guardrails hold vs C0 on the same hours
DECISION_RULE.P_FAIL: any guardrail breached or |G_C1| > 0.03 in a primary stratum
DECISION_RULE.P_INCONCLUSIVE: min N unmet at the hard stop or otherwise
DECISION_RULE.PRODUCT: PASS iff H_PASS and P_PASS; FAIL iff H_FAIL or P_FAIL; else INCONCLUSIVE; a PASS only permits a proposal under PRODUCT_FIRST_DECISION_V1

STOP_CONDITIONS: product rule or context/tape version change during Stage P
gate absent from main at Stage P start
tape completeness below 0.90 in a stratum
any pre-stop read of Stage P exceedance rates (stage void)
NO_LOOKAHEAD: ranks at t use samples strictly before t
weekday type from the window end date only
cuts and rules fixed before any count
C1 may not be modified after Stage H discovery is seen
tercile edges fixed from discovery years only
Stage P read once at the stop

R03 unit files and results as inputs
